page.overview:
What is Barrier Grove?

Barrier Grove is a location in Final Fantasy Dimensions. It's located to the north of Lufenia Ruins. Without the blessing from Oracle of Lufenia, nobody can pass the Barrier Grove as they will find themselves trapped in an infinity loop and can't go further.

The Warriors of Darkness pass through this area with the Oracle of Lufenia's blessing and reach Lufenia Ruins.
